title: Solved once, reused everywhere
statement: Each problem that services share is solved once in a component, so services built from one archetype share one shape and carry little hand-written code.
measure: From a fleet sweep: (a) the hand-written lines in each service's fills over all its lines, as a median across the fleet; (b) the number of services that use each ga component, as a median across ga components.
target: (a) at most 20% and (b) at least 5, within 12 months of the first ga release.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Consumers feed the registry
statement: Teams that consume STEGO find accidental complexity in their services and contribute components upstream, so the common registry grows from the fleet.
measure: The components promoted from a consumer team's local registry into the common registry each quarter, and the share of common registry components first written by a consumer team.
target: At least 1 component promoted each quarter, and at least 30% of common registry components first written by consumer teams, within 12 months of the first ga release.
measured_outside: The platform team counts the promotions and each component's first author from the common registry's history; no test or record in a service repo can see the registry's history.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Auditable by construction
statement: Every service can be audited from its own repo: its record matches its code, regeneration gives the same bytes, its compiler is a qualified release, and every fill it ships is qualified.
measure: From a fleet sweep: the share of services for which all four hold.
target: 100% of swept services, on every sweep.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Fixes reach every service
statement: When a component fix is published, every service built from the defective digest is named at once, and each takes the fix by a pin bump and a new run before the defective digest's fail date.
measure: The time from a supersession until a sweep names every affected service, and the share of affected services that regenerated with the successor before the fail date.
target: Every affected service named within 1 hour, and 100% regenerated before the fail date, for every supersession.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Agents get it right fast
statement: An agent gets from a goal to an accepted declaration and qualified fills in few attempts, because every refusal is structured and names what to change.
measure: On an agent evaluation set of service goals, the median number of stego validate runs from the agent's first declaration to an accepted one.
target: At most 3, on every run of the evaluation set before a release.
measured_outside: The platform team runs an agent on the evaluation set and counts the validate runs from the agent's transcripts; the attempts happen outside STEGO's own tests.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Golden paths stay safe
statement: No golden path includes an experiment, and no service uses a component past its sunset without a dated acceptance.
measure: The ga archetypes that include a component whose stage is not ga, plus the services that use a component past its sunset without an acceptance in their declaration.
target: 0, on every registry release and every sweep.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Evidence for every claim
statement: Every requirement STEGO claims to meet has evidence from a run at an exact commit.
measure: The share of STEGO's own obligations that lathe check counts as designed, built and proved.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.

title: Best of breed
statement: The code STEGO generates is the best known way to solve each problem it solves, the best balance of performance, security and design its authors can reach.
measure: The share of ga components that hold a security review, a benchmark against a reference and a design review at their current digest; and, from the fleet, the high or critical vulnerabilities found in generated code and the performance regressions between component versions.
target: 100% of ga components hold the three reviews at their digest, with 0 high or critical vulnerabilities and 0 unexplained performance regressions, on every registry release.
notes: Set with the Owner on 2026-10-28 from STEGO's principles.
